latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Installs and configures the DefiLlama MCP server for DeFi analytics.

- Provides 23+ DeFi tools for TVL, token prices, protocol metrics, yields, stablecoins, bridges, ETFs, hacks, and more.
- Supports OAuth login with your DefiLlama account—no API keys required.
- Offers instructions for setup across popular agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenClaw, OpenCode, others).
- Includes step-by-step authentication and troubleshooting guidance.
- Details workflow skill installation for guided DeFi research and analytics.
